title: Associate Software Developer
points: Core developer on a cross-platform investor application, building the React Native app from project start through to Play Store release on Android and TestFlight distribution on iOS.

Built a shared web and native codebase where business logic, state, and API layers stay common, with platform-specific view and routing layers so both apps behave consistently without duplicating code.
Created the native component library from scratch over React Native Paper, matching the existing MUI-based web components so developers use the same interface on either platform.
Replaced a paid icon library dependency with a custom SVG-based icon system that renders on both web and native from a single source.

Developed portfolio and fund analytics features on the advisory platform — allocation breakdowns, NAV trends, performance charts, and fund comparison across mutual fund, SIP, and capital gains workflows.
Optimised frontend performance with lazy loading, reduced re-renders, and elimination of duplicate API calls.
